What two web pages say: a short sourced note.

Read these two pages with your WebFetch tool and write `report/note.md` (at most one page of Markdown):

1. https://neurips.cc/Conferences/2026/CallForPapers — quote what it says about the page limit of a submission and the deadline for full papers.
2. https://www.example.com/ — quote its first paragraph.

Try WebFetch first for each page. For each page say which tool read it and quote it exactly. If WebFetch fails on a page, give its exact error before trying anything else; if a page cannot be read at all, say so instead of guessing its content.
